ircc.name: IRCC immigration forecasting
ircc.title: IRCC immigration forecasting
ircc.summary: A capstone forecasting pipeline for Canadian immigration planning: Python ETL, time-series modelling, and evaluation across multiple horizons.
ircc.problem: Planning across immigration categories means working with large datasets, changing trends, and different forecasting horizons.
ircc.decision: Compare Prophet, ARIMA, and Exponential Smoothing across multiple horizons. Treat data preparation and quality as part of the forecasting system.
ircc.evidence: The supplied resume reports 2M+ records processed and 15+ immigration categories covered during the September 2024–April 2025 capstone.
ircc.limits: Capstone project. Scale figures are reported in the supplied resume. No public repository is linked for this capstone.

bogdai.name: BogdAI contract risk review
bogdai.title: BogdAI contract risk review
bogdai.summary: A Microsoft Agents League Hackathon 2026 team prototype that turns synthetic healthcare and pharma contracts into structured, cited risk reports.
bogdai.problem: A risk label is only useful if a reviewer can trace it back to the clause and the policy behind it.
bogdai.decision: Give each agent a bounded responsibility. Microsoft Foundry supports policy grounding and reasoning; a deterministic local fallback keeps demonstrations usable without cloud credentials.
bogdai.evidence: The repository documents six agent roles, structured Pydantic reports, policy citations, human-review flags for high-risk findings, and a full agent trace.
bogdai.limits: Microsoft hackathon team prototype using synthetic contracts and policies. Sree’s individual contribution is not separately documented here. It is not a validated compliance product.
